name: emailoctopus
label: EmailOctopus
description: Email marketing platform for list management, campaign sending, tagging & unsubscribes. Automate contact management and campaign engagement tracking.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
To get your API key:
    1. Log in to your EmailOctopus account.
    2. Go to your **account settings**.
    3. Generate a new API key.
    **Note:** If you have a 'legacy' key, you must generate a new one for API v2.

add_or_update_contact.label: Add / Update Contact
add_or_update_contact.description: Adds a new contact to a list or updates an existing contact if one exists.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Tags to associate with the contact. Existing tags will not be removed.

unsubscribe_contact.label: Unsubscribe Contact
unsubscribe_contact.description: Sets a contact's status to "Unsubscribed" in a specific list.

email_address.label: Email Address
email_address.description: The email address of the contact to unsubscribe.

update_contact_email.label: Update Contact's Email Address
update_contact_email.description: Change the email address of a contact in a list.

current_email_address.label: Current Email Address
current_email_address.description: The contact's current email address used to find them.

new_email_address.label: New Email Address
new_email_address.description: The new email address for the contact.

name.label: List Name
name.description: The name for the new list.

emailoctopus_get_contact.label: Get Contact
emailoctopus_get_contact.description: Gets one contact in a list by ID or email address.

listId.label: List ID
listId.description: The list ID (UUID). Use List Lists to find it.

contact.label: Contact
contact.description: The contact's ID (UUID) or its email address. Both work; an email address is matched case-insensitively.

emailoctopus_list_contacts.label: List Contacts
emailoctopus_list_contacts.description: Lists contacts in a list, filtered by tag, status or dates.

listId.label: List ID
listId.description: The list ID (UUID). Use List Lists to find it.

status.label: Status
status.description: Only contacts with this status. Defaults to subscribed.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Max items to return (1-100). Defaults to 100.

startingAfter.label: Starting After
startingAfter.description: Cursor for the next page: `paging.next.starting_after` from the previous call with the same filters. Leave empty for the first page.

emailoctopus_create_contact.label: Create Contact
emailoctopus_create_contact.description: Adds a new contact to a list.

listId.label: List ID
listId.description: The list ID (UUID). Use List Lists to find it.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field tag, e.g. {"FirstName": "Ada", "Age": 36}. Use Get List to see the list's field tags and types.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Tag names to give the contact.

status.label: Status
status.description: The contact status. Defaults to subscribed.

emailoctopus_upsert_contact.label: Create or Update Contact
emailoctopus_upsert_contact.description: Creates a contact in a list, or updates it if the email already exists.

listId.label: List ID
listId.description: The list ID (UUID). Use List Lists to find it.

emailAddress.label: Email Address
emailAddress.description: The contact's email address, used to match an existing contact.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field tag, e.g. {"FirstName": "Ada", "Age": 36}. Use Get List to see the list's field tags and types.

fieldsToClear.label: Fields to Clear
fieldsToClear.description: Field tags whose value to remove from the contact, e.g. ["FirstName"]. A tag listed here must not also be in Fields.

tagsToAdd.label: Tags to Add
tagsToAdd.description: Tag names to add to the contact. Tags not listed are left as they are.

tagsToRemove.label: Tags to Remove
tagsToRemove.description: Tag names to remove from the contact. Tags not listed are left as they are.

emailoctopus_update_contact.label: Update Contact
emailoctopus_update_contact.description: Updates a contact's email, fields, tags or status.

listId.label: List ID
listId.description: The list ID (UUID). Use List Lists to find it.

contact.label: Contact
contact.description: The contact's ID (UUID) or its email address. Both work; an email address is matched case-insensitively.

newEmailAddress.label: New Email Address
newEmailAddress.description: A new email address for the contact.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field tag, e.g. {"FirstName": "Ada", "Age": 36}. Use Get List to see the list's field tags and types.

fieldsToClear.label: Fields to Clear
fieldsToClear.description: Field tags whose value to remove from the contact, e.g. ["FirstName"]. A tag listed here must not also be in Fields.

tagsToAdd.label: Tags to Add
tagsToAdd.description: Tag names to add to the contact. Tags not listed are left as they are.

tagsToRemove.label: Tags to Remove
tagsToRemove.description: Tag names to remove from the contact. Tags not listed are left as they are.

listId.description: The list ID (UUID). Use List Lists to find it.

newTag.label: New Tag

newFallback.label: New Fallback
newFallback.description: A new default value shown in campaigns when a contact has no value.
